source: MWA correlator, scaled to a 16-tile sub-array of the published 128-tile array

provenance.detail: baselines = n(n-1)/2 for n=32 dual-pol inputs (16 tiles x 2 pol) = 496, split over 8 nodes = 62/node; visibility bytes = baselines x channels x 8 B (complex float32) = 62 x 3072 x 8 = 1523712 B/node/integration; ingest = 30.72 MHz x 2 pol x 1 B x 0.5 s per tile x 2 tiles = 61440000 B/node/integration; duration = the published integration period (products integrated for no more than 0.5 s)
provenance.reference: arXiv:1501.05992 'The Murchison Widefield Array Correlator' (30.72 MHz/pol, 3072 channels, 0.5 s integration, 33024 visibilities, ~800 MB per 1 s unit); array context from SKAO https://www.skao.int/en/science-users/118/ska-telescope-specifications
